name: kb-multimodal-contract-retraction
title: Retract retired KB audio/video model fields from live contracts
description: 审计发现知识库音频/视频模型字段虽然在运行时已 fail-closed，但前后端 live contract 与投影仍继续公开这些字段，需要按新 SaaS 规则收回到非公开拒绝路径。
creator: codex
notes: 2026-04-22 completed: retired KB `audio_model_id` / `video_model_id` overrides are no longer part of the live request or filter contract. Request schemas now reject the presence of those keys before model validation, `KnowledgeBase.__filterable__` no longer exposes them to JSON:API list filters, and command services still fail closed for any direct legacy payloads. Read payload projection and frontend API typings remain retracted from the earlier closeout, so the new SaaS no longer advertises or accepts these retired multimodal KB fields on live surfaces.
